Claim: Does clause 9.2 require Nimbus to keep transfer logs?
Claim type: CT2 params: {'element': 'keep transfer logs'}
As of: 2025-10-17

Target clause 9.2 Cross-border transfer for fraud screening:
Nimbus may transfer order data to its analytics cluster outside India for fraud screening. Such transfers are limited to order identifiers and risk scores, and Nimbus shall keep transfer logs for review.

The proof object has exactly these fields: claim_id, as_of (YYYY-MM-DD, copy from "As of" above), conclusion ("holds" or "does not hold"), premises (list of {fact_id, statement, trust_class} copied verbatim from the admitted premises above), steps (list of step objects, the last one a conclude step). Step kinds and their fields: cite_fact {fact_id}; cite_rule {rule_card_id, citation {source_version_id, provision_id, span [start, end], sha256}} where the citation copies one provision from a lookup_source result (span [0, len(text)] of that provision, sha256 as returned); in_force {provision_id}; compare {value (number), op (one of <=, >=, ==, <, >), bound (number)}; contains_element {clause_id, quote} where quote is a verbatim substring of the target clause text above; role_applies {party, role, clause_id, quote} with the same verbatim quote rule; conclude {conclusion} repeating the proof conclusion. Prefer the smallest proof the checker accepts. The moment verify_derivation returns valid true, call propose_finding in the very next turn with the byte-identical proof object.
